summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for NetScope — Integrated Network Simulation, Protocol Analysis and Performance Optimization Platform. Includes 7 independent pages: TCP Congestion Simulator, Network Topology & Routing, Reliable Transport Protocol Lab (ARQ), LowGuard Network Flood Detection, Packet & Protocol Inspector (PCAP Parser), Performance Benchmarking Lab, and Unified Monitoring Dashboard. All modules integrated with C++ core logic, WASM bridge, and shared sidebar shell.
